# Legroom

> The Legroom Company finds the work eating a business's week and builds the
> systems that do it instead. Based in Washington, working with youth sports
> and home services businesses.

We give owners their legroom back. We do your legwork.

## The offer
- A free 45-minute business breakdown. A sit-down, not a report drop.
- We map how work moves through the business, size what the manual version
  costs in hours and dollars, and hand over a one-page ranking of the two
  automations worth building first.
- The one page is yours whether or not we work together.
- Builds are quoted flat before any work starts. First build is usually live
  in two to four weeks. Two new builds a month.

## Results
- EL1 (youth sports): 10x ROAS in under three months
- Salon Savoir (beauty salon): +200% monthly revenue
- GradMasters (education tech): $30,000 saved in development costs
- Formidable (newsletter SaaS): 2.5x subscribers in under three months
